title: Hardening Agentic Web Populations Through Multi-Criterion Competitive Co-Evolution: Lessons from Wargame Strategy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.19319v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents on the open web will face adversaries that keep adapting, so a defense that is only tested once will eventually be found and broken. We propose treating jailbreak attacks and safety guardrails as two populations that evolve against each other, rather than as a fixed attacker probing a fixed defense. This idea comes directly from wargame strategy optimization, where two-population competitive co-evolution with alternating evolution cycles and cross-play evaluation has already been shown to produce strategies that are robust to a moving opponent, and where a companion line of work has shown that the same machinery can measure how much competitive pressure a population must absorb. However, real-world applications can never rely on a single criterion as a key performance indicator, rather must use multiple conflicting criteria, such as, cost and efficiency. We describe how this mechanism transfers to language model safety, argue why

translated_title: 通过多准则竞争性协同进化强化智能体网络种群：来自兵棋推演策略优化的启示
translated_abstract: 开放网络上的智能体将面临不断适应的对手，因此仅经过一次性测试的防御最终会被发现并攻破。我们提出将越狱攻击与安全防护机制视为两个相互对抗进化的种群，而非固定的攻击者探测固定的防御。这一思想直接来源于兵棋推演策略优化：在该领域中，采用交替进化周期与交叉对局评估的双种群竞争性协同进化，已被证明能够产生对移动对手具有鲁棒性的策略；同时，一项配套研究工作表明，同样的机制还可以衡量一个种群必须吸收多少竞争压力。然而，现实世界的应用永远无法依赖单一准则作为关键性能指标，而必须采用多个相互冲突的准则，例如成本与效率。我们描述了这一机制如何迁移至语言模型安全领域，并论证了为什么……
tldr: 该论文借鉴兵棋推演策略优化的经验，提出将越狱攻击与安全防护视为两个相互对抗进化的种群，通过多准则竞争性协同进化机制持续强化智能体网络的安全防御能力。
en_tdlr: Drawing lessons from wargame strategy optimization, this paper proposes hardening agentic web safety by treating jailbreak attacks and guardrails as two competitively co-evolving populations evaluated under multiple conflicting criteria.
